checks.name: non_regression_boundedness
checks.interpretation: If final score is between first score and ceiling, WQ lies in [0, 1].

checks.name: intelligence_wisdom_separation
checks.interpretation: First-round competence and after-experience improvement can rank systems differently.

checks.name: positive_wq_non_identifiability
checks.interpretation: The same score trace can come from learning or from hidden round scheduling; provenance is required.

checks.name: task_mix_simpson_trap
checks.interpretation: Changing task mixtures can reverse rankings; fixed weights and stratified reports are mandatory.

checks.name: ceiling_sensitivity
checks.interpretation: Near-ceiling denominators amplify small regressions; report raw deltas and clipped variants.

checks.name: macro_accounting
checks.interpretation: A macro is admissible only after paying definition/glossary cost.

checks.name: evidence_gate_minimum
checks.interpretation: A leaderboard cell is not admissible when checkpoint/factory provenance is missing.
